selection_rule: Execute the first non-complete task whose dependencies and authority boundary are satisfied. Missing evidence is never success; duplicate execution is prohibited by experiment_id and packet destination.

tasks.note: The broader Human-LLM Interoperability workflow remains a separate repository-wide validation surface and had unrelated legacy failures; it is not used to overstate this bounded gate.

tasks.completion_condition: Hash-bound inputs, five conditions, deterministic slots, duplicate prevention, and initialization receipt are installed and exercised.
Mutation, missing evidence, identity collision, and invalid result binding fail closed.

tasks.trigger: A governed source packet, nominal prompt, trajectory packet, participant assignments, evaluator assignments, and observation records are committed or supplied to the packet lane.
tasks.next_action: Initialize ATTR-001 with tools/init_attribution_trajectory_packet.py, collect the required controlled observations, bind the result, and run tools/verify_attribution_trajectory_packet.py.
tasks.release_condition: ATTR-001 verifies with all required conditions, independent evaluators, acceptable contamination risk, and a bounded derived outcome.
tasks.human_authority_boundary: Participant and evaluator contributions must be authentic; repository automation may initialize, validate, reject, receipt, and route them but may not fabricate observations.

tasks.release_condition: AT-010 produces a verified bounded outcome with immutable evidence references.
tasks.next_action: Read each destination *_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md and propagate only the verified controls, evidence, bounded result, and no-overclaim boundary.
